title: Dur-Sharrukin founded
summary: Sargon II begins his new capital, Dur-Sharrukin (Khorsabad).
description: Sargon II begins his new capital, Dur-Sharrukin (Khorsabad). Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 717, p. 44; section “Confirmation from the Lachish Reliefs”, p. 26).
